findings.problem: es has a 'many' CLDR category (exact multiples of 10^6); these two plural keys have no 'many' arm, unlike the other 56 es plurals. Counts are diff line counts, so 10^6 is unreachable and ICU falls back to 'other' with grammatical text.
findings.suggestion: add many {… # de líneas …} for completeness
